title: 第21章 罗恩的特长第22章 痛打落水狗
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
半个小时后，战场已经打扫完毕。
这次一共杀了三十一名石溪领的士兵，包括一个高阶骑士扈从，一个中阶，四个低阶，农奴一个一个的被抓回来，蹲在空地上。
被俘的几个活口也已经审讯完了，面对折磨，这几人只求速死。
审问结果摆到罗恩面前时，天色已经蒙蒙亮。
石溪岭的基本情况摸清了。
彼得手下只有一个高阶骑士扈从。
就是昨晚被杀的，是彼得本人的护卫队长，一直跟在彼得身边。
占据盐矿的这些天，面对周围来的骚扰，彼得不得不派遣高阶骑士坐镇，这可就便宜了罗恩。
彼得带来开拓地的人还有中阶五个，这次死了两个，还剩三个。低阶十几个，昨晚死了四个，还剩七八个。
卫兵总共一百多，昨晚折了三十多个，还剩一百三四。
钱是从红枫伯爵府带出来的，据说有一万多金龙的家底，精灵虫也有九只。
不得不说，虽说只是一个普通的伯爵子嗣，富裕程度也是秒杀了罗恩这个穷逼。
但开拓地花钱如流水，修城堡、买农奴、招募士兵，已经花了一半。
彼得这次敢来占盐场，是因为他以为罗恩是个软柿子。河湾领被马匪放火的消息被传遍了，周围领主都在看笑话。
尤其是盐场位于河湾领东部，离石溪领和黑石领最近。彼得觉得自己捡了个便宜，抢先下手占据了盐矿。
至于其他领主……彼得仗着有红枫伯爵撑腰谁都没放在眼里。
彼得最看不起鲍里斯，觉得他不过是个骑士出身的暴发户，说不定是个卖钩子的。
茂林领的领主，这种平民出身的穷鬼，彼得老爷到现在都没记住他的名字。
总之在彼得老爷看来，这一片荒原的开拓领主，不是老就是残，都是路边一条。
所以行事才如此嚣张。

罗恩听完石溪领的情报，沉默了一会儿。
“被审的那些人呢？”
格雷道：“在外面，和其他尸体一起。”
罗恩点点头：“把所有尸体运回天坑埋了，咱们的人好生下葬。”
罗恩看着打扫好的战场，武器、铠甲、粮食、工具，一车车往庄园里拉。光是长剑就收了十多把，皮甲二十多副，粮食够吃半个月。
最值钱的是那批农奴，五百二十三个人，男女老少都有。
他们蹲在盐场外的空地上，瑟瑟发抖，不知道自己会被怎么处置。
罗恩走过去，站在他们面前。
人群安静下来，几百双眼睛盯着他。
格雷道：“大人，这些农奴有的拖家带口，有的亲人还在石溪领那边，怕是不会老实啊！”
罗恩呵呵一笑：
“不用担心，马上他们亲人就能团聚了。”
“让农奴们互相检举，把那些可能犯事的拉去烧砖。”他吩咐道。
“把这些收获送回去之后，带上人跟我劫掠石溪领，动作要快，兵贵神速。”
“是！”手下兴奋道。
content_en:
Half an hour later, the battlefield had been cleaned.
This time, a total of thirty-one soldiers from the Stone Brook Territory were killed, including one high-level knight retinue, one mid-level, and four low-level serfs. The serfs were captured one by one and squatted in the open space.
The interrogations of the few survivors who were captured have also been completed. Facing torture, these people just wanted to die quickly.
When the results of the interrogation were placed in front of Ron, it was already dark.
The basic situation of Shixiling has been figured out.
Peter had only one high-ranking knight retinue.
The one who was killed last night was Peter's own guard captain, who had been with Peter.
During these days of occupying the salt mine, facing the harassment from all around, Peter had to send high-level knights to take charge, which was an advantage for Ron.
There were five middle-level people brought by Peter to open up the land. Two of them died this time, and three were left. There are more than a dozen low-level people, four died last night, and there are seven or eight left.
There are more than one hundred guards in total. More than thirty were lost last night, leaving one hundred and thirty-four left.
The money was brought from Earl Hongfeng's Mansion. It is said that the family has more than 10,000 golden dragons and nine elf bugs.
It has to be said that even though he is just an ordinary heir of an earl, his wealth is enough to kill a poor guy like Ron.
But the money spent to open up the land was like water. Half of it was already spent on building castles, buying serfs, and recruiting soldiers.
Peter dared to come to occupy the salt field this time because he thought Ron was a soft persimmon. The news that the Riverbend Territory was set on fire by horse bandits spread widely, and the surrounding lords were laughing.
In particular, the salt farm is located in the eastern part of the Riverbend Territory, closest to the Stone Creek Territory and the Blackstone Territory. Peter thought he had gotten a bargain and took over the salt mine first.
As for the other lords... Peter relied on the support of Earl Hongfeng to ignore anyone.
Peter looked down on Boris the most, thinking that he was just an upstart knight, maybe a hook seller.
The lord of Maolin Territory, a poor man from a commoner background, Master Peter still hasn't remembered his name.
In short, in Master Peter's opinion, the pioneering lords of this wasteland are either old or disabled, and they are just by the wayside.
That's why he acts so arrogantly.
Ron was silent for a while after hearing the information from Stone Brook Leader.
"Where are those on trial?"
Gray said: "Outside, with the other corpses."
Ron nodded: "Take all the corpses back to the sinkhole and bury them, so that our people can be buried alive."
Ron looked at the cleaned battlefield, with weapons, armor, food, and tools being pulled toward the manor. I have collected more than a dozen long swords, more than 20 pairs of leather armors, and enough food for half a month.
The most valuable ones were the serfs, 523 of them, men, women, old and young.
They squatted in the open space outside the salt field, shivering, not knowing what would happen to them.
Ron walked over and stood in front of them.
The crowd fell silent and hundreds of pairs of eyes stared at him.
Gray said: "Sir, some of these serfs have their families, and some of their relatives are still with Shixi leader. I'm afraid they won't be honest!"
Ron chuckled:
"Don't worry, their relatives will be reunited soon."
"Let the serfs report each other and drag those who may have committed crimes to burn bricks," he ordered.
"After sending these harvests back, bring some people with me to plunder the Shixi Territory. You must move quickly, and your soldiers must be quick."
"Yes!" his subordinate said excitedly.
